name: Logo build
oneLiner: one continuous shot: dots whip into the real logo, real pages fly past in 3D, a real query is typed and sent, a 3D carousel of real pages turns, accent strokes resolve back into the logo
bestFor: software and AI products with a strong mark and a real input (search, ask, prompt, command bar); feature launches and app intros; short 9:16 teasers
motion: dots pop and slide into a row, bend onto an arc and whip 3 turns into the mark (back.out(2.2)); cards fly through z with tumbling rotation (power1.in); a bar grows from a pill (back.out(1.6)); carousel turns on the beat (power3.inOut); strokes draw on and off with getTotalLength
ground: warm paper #F4F3EF with two soft brand-accent light pools and one warm pool, slowly drifting, multiply grain

sound.ui: one tick per dot, a whoosh on the whip and the fly-past, a pop as the mark and the bar land, typing under the query, a click on the press, a tick per carousel turn, one hit on the final mark
